plain: Having to do with bishops, or a church run by bishops.

webster.text: Belonging to or vested in bishops or prelates; as episcopal jurisdiction; episcopal authority.

example.quote: I believe a majority of the community are Presbyterians. 1 am, for my part, against any exclusive establishment ; but if there were any, I would prefer the Episcopal.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. HENRY ABBOT, July 30, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
